facts.statement: LSR bit 0 reports 1 when at least one received character is in FIFO.
facts.quote:
‘1’ – At least one character has been received and is in the
FIFO.

facts.statement: LSR bit 0 reports 0 when no characters in FIFO.
IIR bit 0 indicates interrupt pending when 0 and no interrupt pending when 1.
facts.quote:
Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’. When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR bits 3-1 report highest priority pending interrupt with stated source and reset control, including 011 Receiver Line Status.
facts.quote:
0 1 1 1 st Receiver Line
Status
Parity, Overrun or Framing
errors or Break Interrupt
Reading the Line
Status Register
